description: arXiv:2609.24061v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper, we propose MECT, a speaker verification model that integrates the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism into a CNN-Transformer backbone with optimized block structure and stacking scheme. Specifically, we investigated four MoE variants that span utterance-level and frame-level granularity with dense and sparse routing strategies. The...
